name: DiBa Tag Manager Cookie Warn
description: Adds a Google Tag Manager container with Consent Mode v2 defaults and a multilingual (ca/es/en) cookie-consent banner for DiBa sites.
project_description: Submodule of DiBa Integration that injects a Google Tag Manager container together with a cookie-consent banner sourced from the DiBa corporate front-end assets (maqueta.diba.cat). It configures Google Consent Mode v2 (ad_storage / analytics_storage) defaults and accept/reject states, adds the google-site-verification meta tag, and renders a multilingual (Catalan/Spanish/English) consent message with a configurable privacy-policy link and cookie expiry via hook_page_attachments and hook_page_top.
